statement: Evidence-based ledger. PROVEN means exercised by the cited automated gate in the stated environment, for the stated scope only. It is not a production certification.

subsystems.capability: Endpoint telemetry to finding, incident, evidence, asset/identity resolution and investigation graph
subsystems.limitation: One detector scenario (repeated authentication failures). Detector, graph and correlator windows are per-process memory.

subsystems.capability: Tenant/site isolation in API, fabric ingest and PostgreSQL row-level security
subsystems.environment: ubuntu-latest, PostgreSQL 17 with a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS application role
subsystems.limitation: RLS provides no backstop for a superuser connection; production must connect as a non-bypass role.

subsystems.capability: JWKS/JWT bearer authentication and cookie session, identical across control-plane instances
subsystems.limitation: No real external identity provider, key rotation in production, or SSO flow was exercised.

subsystems.capability: Site Controller to control plane over real mTLS, outage, restart and durable replay
subsystems.limitation: Loopback network; no WAN latency, packet loss or real certificate authority operations.

subsystems.capability: Durable outbox, duplicate safety and failure/recovery of the event fabric
subsystems.limitation: Failure injection is in-process; no chaos testing of real networks.

subsystems.capability: Two control-plane instances behind a reverse proxy on shared PostgreSQL; failover, rejoin, concurrent-duplicate safety
subsystems.limitation: Detector windows are per-instance memory, so a burst split across instances can under-detect. Two instances only.

subsystems.capability: Automatic PostgreSQL failover and replication
subsystems.limitation: No PostgreSQL cluster, replica promotion or connection failover was tested.

subsystems.capability: Multi-region replication and disaster recovery
subsystems.limitation: Only single-site logical backup/restore is exercised; no cross-region infrastructure exists.

subsystems.capability: PostgreSQL logical backup, restore into a fresh database and integrity verification
subsystems.limitation: Logical dump only; no point-in-time recovery or encrypted off-site storage.

subsystems.capability: Site Controller durable-state snapshot, verify and restore
subsystems.limitation: Snapshots are files; no automated scheduling, retention or off-host copy.

subsystems.capability: BLOCK_IP apply, verify, rollback, reconcile with nftables in a disposable namespace and on a disposable privileged host, IPv4 and IPv6
subsystems.limitation: Rule state is verified, not packet flow. firewalld and ufw were not exercised. Only the runner Ubuntu image and iptables-nft coexistence were tested.

subsystems.capability: BLOCK_IP apply, verify, rollback, reconcile with Windows Defender Firewall, IPv4 and IPv6
subsystems.limitation: Rule state is verified through Get-NetFirewallRule, not packet flow. No Group Policy or third-party firewall coexistence.

subsystems.capability: Real enterprise firewall / NAC appliance enforcement
subsystems.limitation: No vendor appliance, appliance API credential or lab was available.

subsystems.capability: Cloud security-group / firewall enforcement
subsystems.limitation: No cloud account, credentials or environment were used.

subsystems.capability: Upstream ISP or DDoS-provider mitigation integration
subsystems.limitation: No provider integration exists or was tested.

subsystems.capability: Windows collector as an SCM service: install, start, stop, restart, crash observation, uninstall, state preservation, upgrade/rollback
subsystems.limitation: No automatic crash recovery is configured. Security-log reading was observed on the runner but volume and event coverage are not certified.

subsystems.capability: Linux endpoint collector under a hardened systemd unit
subsystems.limitation: auditd process-execution evidence under the packaged unit was not exercised end to end.

subsystems.capability: Windows MSI and Linux .deb install, start, stop, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, state preservation
subsystems.limitation: Unsigned. No apt repository, RPM, GPO/SCCM/Intune tooling, or in-place downgrade.

subsystems.capability: Deterministic manifest, CycloneDX SBOMs, GitHub attestations and independent verification of the exact artifact set
subsystems.limitation: Attestations prove build provenance, not code-signing trust. PyInstaller output is not bit-reproducible.

subsystems.capability: Production Authenticode and package signing
subsystems.limitation: No production signing certificate or GPG key exists; every artifact is unsigned and CI asserts NotSigned.

subsystems.capability: Operator console: authenticated context, incident, evidence, asset/identity, investigation path, containment capability, response/policy/recovery state, audit history, tenant-scoped navigation
subsystems.environment: ubuntu-latest, Chromium (Playwright), real backend, real nftables in a namespace
subsystems.limitation: The scenario enrolls no sensor, so the fleet view is proven only for its honest empty state. There is no Network Health metric with a documented source, and independent verification state is not displayed in the console.

subsystems.capability: Bounded ingest load, latency percentiles, process CPU/RAM samples, restart recovery
subsystems.environment: ubuntu-latest, one uvicorn instance over TLS, PostgreSQL 17
subsystems.limitation: Evidence for the tested event count, concurrency and 30 s duration on one runner only; no SLO or capacity claim.

subsystems.capability: Broad Linux distribution and kernel coverage
subsystems.environment: only the runner Ubuntu image was tested
subsystems.limitation: No other distribution, kernel, or firewall manager combination was exercised.

subsystems.capability: Broad Windows version coverage
subsystems.limitation: No Windows client or older server version was exercised.

subsystems.capability: Operation on real customer production networks
subsystems.limitation: No customer pilot or production deployment exists.
